Welcome to Scary Stories. This is a Roblox horror story game!

For best experience play in a dark room with full volume.
[WARNING] This game contains flashing lights and loud noises...

Have suggestions or want to report a bug? Post it in the group!
https://www.roblox.com/groups/8502026/SuperbStudios#!/about

If this version is not scary enough for you play the original version here:
https://www.roblox.com/games/100989771338545
